changed_fields.old: Direct force through a lead leg and finish with an independent forward arm release.
changed_fields.new: Use a controlled lateral plant to initiate grounded hip rotation and a diagonal upper-body finish. Retain forward leg and independent arm projection as supporting force work.

changed_fields.old: Keep ankle contacts brief while sustaining a forceful arm finish.
changed_fields.new: Organize a forward plant into a grounded hip turn and compact rotational hand arc. Ankle rebound, a supported split-leg rise and linear arm pressing/pulling support that base and finish.

changed_fields.old: Connect lead-leg support to a short upward or forward drive, with a decisive arm draw.
changed_fields.new: Drive laterally from a held split stance into an open rotational base and an outward upper-body release. Lead-leg ascent, a short linear start and arm draws reinforce support and the pulling finish.

changed_fields.old: Carry lower-body extension and upper-body pressing force through a controlled finish.
changed_fields.new: Initiate controlled hip internal rotation and produce a lead-hand rotational pushing release. Grounded knee-to-ankle drive and linear arm presses supply supporting initiation and finishing force.

changed_fields.old: Connect a retained hip return to force and use one brief hand-contact link before resetting.
changed_fields.new: Accept a lateral arrival into a grounded hip turn and arrest a retained upper-body rotational arc. Linked hand pushes and leg-driven projection support a controlled impulse and finish.

changed_fields.old: Maintain lead-leg drive and a clear arm finish while keeping midpoint volume modest.
changed_fields.new: Consolidate direct hip external-rotation force and retained rotational pulling at the reduced planned dose. Small lead-leg and linear arm-force tasks support an organized base and finish.

changed_fields.old: Drive from a controlled single-leg position and finish a guided or free upper-body projection.
changed_fields.new: Reorganize a grounded stance into rotational knee drive and a controlled upper-body hand sweep. Single-leg support and guided or free forward pressing reinforce force transfer.

changed_fields.old: Carry a small ankle impulse forward and finish a deliberate upper-body pull.
changed_fields.new: Practice separate hip-led low kicking and a descending upper-body rotational release, then regain controlled support. Small ankle advances, grounded leg return and linear arm draws support onset and finish.

changed_fields.old: Use a controlled plant to direct traction or leg-driven projection.
changed_fields.new: Generate compact folded-leg and hand sweeps through controlled hip and trunk turns. Grounded lunge return, leg-driven forward projection and linear arm traction supply plant and finish support.

changed_fields.old: Produce a split-base leg impulse and a deliberate arm release after a small reception.
changed_fields.new: Initiate a compact hip-turning thigh action from the early cue and express a separate unloaded upper-body backhand arc. Split-base leg force and catch-set forward release support an organized start and finish.

changed_fields.old: Finish a small contact or leg-driven impulse with organized forward projection.
changed_fields.new: Place crossover recovery into a controlled rotational base and couple a separate step-in hip turn to an upper-body pushing release. Small linear leg, ankle and arm-force tasks support placement and the finish.

changed_fields.old: Review controlled lead-leg support and an alternating or independent arm finish.
changed_fields.new: Review a low hip-led rotational kick with lateral recovery and a retained upper-body rotational pull. Supported lead-leg work and alternating or independent forward arm actions provide small linear-force support; no improvement is inferred without matched actual records.
